sector.narrative: Water sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative: General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The objectives for the project period were to organize rural communities for Integrated Water Resource Management, to increase awareness about impact of climate change and adaptive measures, to promote sustainable river management at national level and to enhance the capacity of TBS for its sustainability as organization. The following results have been achieved: - Regular meetings at village level conducted, sessions of River Parliament organized, woil and water conservation work done, increased plantation of trees. - 50 rallies organized, model for organic agriculture developed, 2000 children educated. - Organization of 11 conventions at national level to promote sustainable river management. - Increased capacity in fundraising skills, creation of databas of potential donors and meetings with international development agencies. TBS's assessment is that the prospects of getting support from new partners are good.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
